SubbaReddy M Email: subbareddy6055@gmail.com Mobile:9986766055

SAP EWM / LE-WM CONSULTANT

Professional Summary:

Total experience of 10+ years in SAP LE-WM / EWM functional which includes SAP Implementation, Roll Outs & Post Implementation Support.

Certified Associate EWM consultant • Experience on EWMimplementation project • Knowledge of Cross Modules Integration for EWM/WM& MM, EWM/WM & SD, EWM/WM & QM, EWM /WM & PP.

Excellent communication skills, exceptional ability to perform individually, good interpersonal relations, motivated & hard working individual.

Experience on preparing functional Specifications, test scripts, and user-understanding documents.

Configuration and Customization of Extended Warehouse Management, Warehouse Management, Materials Management.

Design, Development and Configuration of RF in SAP WM & EWM • Excellent communication and presentation skills and Client Oriented attitude. • Experience of working in a project environment and supporting clients in designing and implementing their objectives in innovative and high magnitude projects. • Excellent capability to explore, learn and understand Client business process. • Experience on SAP Decentralize warehouses with 3PL logistics • Knowledge on inventory management.

Professional Experience: Project 9#: Company : Cognizant Duration : Jul 2023 to Till date Client : Organon Role : SAP EWM Support & Rollout Designation: Sr Associate consultant Responsibilities:

Responsible for handling tickets on daily basis. • • • • Interacting with the client and Key Users on daily basis to resolve the queries. • Providing Production support include solving the issue on day to basis • • • • Identifying the New WRICEF object along with business users. • • • • Worked on Minor configuration Changes and Enhancement • • • • Involved on Data Migration activities

Project 8#: Company : Cognizant Duration : Mar 2023 to Jun-2023 Client : Nexperia Role : SAP EWM Implementation Designation: Sr Associate consultant Responsibilities:

• • • Worked on Minor configuration Changes and Enhancement • • • • Involved on SIT testing • • • • Involved on EWM data upload.

Project 7#:

Company : TCS

Duration : Jul 2022 to Mar 2023 Client : Honeywell Role : SAP WM Support Designation: Assistant consultant Responsibilities:

Responsible for handling tickets on daily basis. • • • • Interacting with the client and Key Users on daily basis to resolve the queries. • Providing Production support include solving the issue on day to basis • Worked on Minor configuration Changes and Enhancement

Project 6#:

Company : IBM India Pvt Ltd Duration : Jul 2021 to Jun 2022 Client : AMNS (Arcelor Mittal Nippon Steel)) Role : SAP S4 EWM Implementation Designation: Package Specialist Responsibilities:

• • • AS-IS and TO-BE discussion with client . • • • • Preparing BPP document and walkthrough with client . • Experience in configuring EWM integrated modules MM, SD,QM processes and EWM Organization structure setup

Configured storage control process, WOCR, Queue and Resource Management, package specification, Yard Management, Cross docking

Experience in defining internal process configuration & execution of replenishment ,posting change ,physical inventory , adhoc product movements

Setup ECC -EWM integration and troubleshooting the integration issues related CIF & QRFC • • • • Identifying the New WRICEF object along with business users. • • • • Experience on preparing Test scripts , Unit Testing and User Training Documents . • • • • Involved on EWM data migration programs.

Project 5#:

Company : Capgemini Duration : Dec 2018 to Jul 2021 Client : Abbott ( st jude medicals) Role : SAP WM Rollout& Development Designation: SAP WM consultant Responsibilities:

Engaged in client meetings to gather change requirements for warehouse and Plant operations.

Warehouse Management configuration settings like warehouse number, storage types, and storage sections.

Defining and assigning storage type indicators, storage section indicators, storage unit types, storage bin types and other master data.

Configuring necessary settings for put away and picking strategies, storage type search, storage section search, and storage bin type search etc

Worked in the area of Handling Units, Packing master data, RF Scanners, STO and Inventory Management

Worked on Replenishment , Cross docking ,Resource Managment Yard Management • worked in Handling Unit Management, Storage Unit Management, Batch Management • Worked extensively on the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) & integration testing (script) of MM- IM –WM in new changes

Worked on SAP Decentralized warehosues with 3PL logistics • Responsible for writing the Knowledge transfer documentation and doing the Knowledge transfer to End-user training documentation

Post go-Live support

• Resolved various Authorization related issues and handled the stabilization Period

Worked on various printer related issues • Given training on existing processes to the New users • As a part of Go live added new jobs • Given status reports to the end user as end user does not have the table access

Project 4#:

Company : Schneider Electric Duration : Nov 2016 to Dec 2018 Client : Schneider Bridge Role : SAP WM Development & Support Designation: SAP MM/WM consultant

Responsibilities:

Engaged in client meetings to gather change requirements for warehouse and Plant operations.

Worked in the area of Handling Units, Packing master data, RF Scanners, STO and Inventory Management

worked in Handling Unit Management, Storage Unit Management, Batch Management • Worked extensively on the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) & integration testing (script) of MM- IM –WM in new changes

Responsible for writing the Knowledge transfer documentation and doing the Knowledge transfer to End-user training documentation

Resolve user problems and operational issues, including providing fixes to existing configuration for the business processes and functionality currently implemented and operational at Clients.

Resolving MM and WM issues and queries to support day-to-day operations under a specific service level agreement. • Tracking issues to closure • Responsibility also included identification of training needs develop training material and

conducting extensive training.

Testing the new Enhancement functionality and training the end users. • Involved in configuration changes.

Project 3#:

Company : Fujitsu Consulting Duration : April 2016 to Oct 2016 Client : Farmland foods Role : SAP WM Support Designation: Functional consultant

Responsibilities:

Responsible for handling tickets on daily basis. • Interacting with the client and Key Users on daily basis to resolve the queries. • Providing Production support include solving the issue on day to basis. • Changed printing parameters for storage types in the warehouse • Resolved print related issues

Project 2#:

Company : Schneider Electric Duration : Oct 2015 to April 2016 Client : Schneider Electric – FSL Australia Role : SAP WM Roll out Designation: SAP WM consultant

Responsibilities:

Warehouse Management configuration settings like warehouse number, storage types, and storage sections.

Defining and assigning storage type indicators, storage section indicators, storage unit types, storage bin types and other master data.

Configuring necessary settings for put away and picking strategies, storage type search, storage section search, and storage bin type search etc.

Mapping various business processes like background TO creation and confirmation, direct put away to fixed bin, special picking process like 2 step picking, posting changes, physical inventory, automatic replenishment control

Configured the settings of WM application interface to Quality management, Production planning, and Inventory management components. • Setting up the print controls in warehouse management • RF Configuration.

Project 1#:

Company : Tech Mahindra Duration : Oct 2014 to Sep 2015 Client : NUSA Role : SAP WM Support Designation: SAP WM consultant

Responsibilities:

Handling Support Calls as L1. • Tickets that arise from customers and solving them on severity basis. • worked On IDoc Monitoring • Worked on IDoc related issues like Goods Issue, Goods Receipt, Inventory Adjustment IDoc failures.

Worked on Load Close Issues. • Worked on Shipment Updating related Activities. • Involved in Client meetings to understand the business to resolve the issues. • Worked on IDoc related tickets. • Involved in Testing activities every month starting. • Worked on CR's and CR Testing • Setting up the print controls in warehouse management

Educational Qualification:

B.Tech from JNTU University FY 2011, Hyderabad with 61%

Place:

Date : (Subba Reddy M)
